checks.name: pass_through
checks.detail: SET through the proxy is visible on Redis

checks.name: request_not_applied
checks.detail: SET dropped before forward left the old value

checks.name: response_applied
checks.detail: INCR ran and the client did not receive the integer

aaa.arrange: Redis is up. The proxy is a pass-through.
aaa.act: SET through the proxy, drop the next SET before forward, drop the INCR reply after Redis runs it.
aaa.assert: The first SET sticks. The dropped SET does not. The INCR changes the value without a client reply.
